assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The receipt date, queue number, adverse-action isolation, and offline completion figures are synthetic tabletop assertions, not legal effects or observed service performance.
assumptions.impact: A professional and legal review must define the applicable procedure, authority, retention period, accessibility route, and emergency exception before any real pilot.

assumptions.statement: No real institution, public counter, claimant, case record, identity data, or operational channel is represented; provisional geometry is only a conceptual carrier.
assumptions.impact: Replace synthetic fixtures and provisional polygons with cleared, institution-approved evidence before implementation discussion.
